items.summary: Ensure Community Medicine is recognized as a distinct subject in the frontend subject definitions (frontend/src/domain/subjects.ts) with all its class types (Theory, Practical, etc.) properly enumerated, matching the same structure used by Anatomy, Physiology, and Biochemistry.

Fix the Dashboard page (frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx) to display a SubjectStatsCard for Community Medicine alongside Anatomy, Physiology, and Biochemistry, so attendance statistics for Community Medicine are visible and up to date.

Fix the Today's Schedule section on the Dashboard (frontend/src/components/TodaySchedule.tsx) and the Add Class page (frontend/src/pages/AddClassPage.tsx) so that Community Medicine timetable entries appear in today's schedule and Community Medicine can be selected as a subject when manually adding a class log.

Ensure Community Medicine is available as a filter option in the Records page (frontend/src/pages/RecordsPage.tsx) and appears correctly in the Analytics page (frontend/src/pages/AnalyticsPage.tsx) subject-wise statistics.

Audit the storage models (frontend/src/storage/models.ts) to confirm that the ClassLog and TimetableEntry subject type unions include 'Community Medicine' as a valid literal, and update them if missing so that storing and retrieving Community Medicine records works correctly.
